candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi Naveed,

Our small nonprofit organization (<http://silverpine-studio.example|silverpine-studio.example>) is launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, it would be ready by the end of next week (thursday or friday). If you can help, I can send the video, a google doc containing thumbnail ideas and guidance, and one thumbnail I tried making myself. We would prefer the thumbnail not to contain AI-created assets, although minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay. Would you be able to help?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: If that works for you, I'd prefer to take my image from the video itself.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I'd prefer that you not use either of those methods—please don't generate new elements or alter parts of the photographs that way.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: What we consider acceptable is limited AI editing, such as using photoshop's generative fill to remove a distracting prop from the background.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: You're welcome to share the examples, since I'm curious about your process. However, if it involves uploading images to ChatGPT/Gemini/Midjourney/etc. and asking the service to make changes, we would probably veto that approach.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Unfortunately, these examples appear to be wholesale AI content generation, even when existing photos are used as the starting point. We would prefer that this not be done; I hope that restriction works for you.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Thank you—that revised workflow works great.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi Naveed,

I'm very sorry for the delayed response, and thank you for creating these. We ultimately selected a different thumbnail for the video, so we won't be using the submitted designs, but I appreciate your help. Because payment is late on our end, I'll pay next Friday and include a bonus.

Thanks again for all your help!

Caleb
